page.overview:
Who is Cheerleaders?

The cheerleaders (チアガール chiagāru) are a group of characters in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's.

The cheerleaders supported Jack Atlas when he Dueled Hunter Pace. One of them was identical in appearance to Blair Flannigan.

The cheerleaders performed while walking through the stands during Team 5D's and Team Unicorn's Duel in the World Racing Grand Prix. They stopped their routine when they were surprised to see Jean hesitated to end his turn, when it would result in guaranteed victory.
